heat_pump.notes: ArenaEV lists a heat pump on this VinFast trim (2022 sheet; the VF8 Plus sheet says "For Europe, USA & Canada"). Model year 2023 carried from 2022 and Plus Performance carried from the Plus page. ArenaEV is a spec aggregator and no maker page was found; the page is a European-market sheet unless stated. ArenaEV lists "Heat pump: Yes" without saying standard or optional, and its pages mix EU data.
